verdict.rationale: Working Copy stores SSH/private keys under an 'Identity' that can be generated/imported and optionally kept in the Secure Enclave protected by Face ID/Touch ID, which functions as a secure credential vault, and identities can in principle be reused across repositories. However, the docs never explicitly describe attaching one Identity/credential to multiple different remote hosts or hosting providers, and there is no independent/hands-on confirmation of this workflow. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of reusing a single stored credential across multiple distinct hosts, and independent verification of this vault behavior.
